review.intent_summary: Provide explicitly requested charts that make structured anomaly evidence easier to inspect while preserving its meaning and limitations.

criteria.criterion: 1. Default to text, require an explicit visualization request, and separate quick and detailed figure instructions.
2. Render one dataset's observations, expectations, actual triggers, and labeled initialization, units, and reviewed reset boundaries.
criteria.notes: Reset boundaries appear as dashed lines without a reset label or legend entry; the other required elements are implemented.

criteria.criterion: 3. Reject multi-dataset results and require explicit overwrite of an existing output.
4. Preserve indices, evidence maturity, detection timing, incomplete status, and interpretation limits in detailed figures.

verification_evidence: tests/test_skill_chart.py: observed-evidence, provisional-evidence, reviewed-reset, and multi-dataset checks passed; the overwrite test initially encountered a temporary-directory permission error.
Manually reviewed the Skill's request gating and detailed figure instructions against the acceptance criteria.
remaining_gaps: Add a reset-boundary label or legend entry and an assertion checking it; the existing reset test checks line counts and initialization labels only.
Rendered visual inspection of the spike chart remains outstanding.
